text:
priya-support: Customer forwarded API error when applying promo code SPRING-50-NA. Says dashboard lists expiry 2026-03-20 but API returns PROMO_INVALID.

priya-support: API response pasted:
```
{
  "error": { "code": "PROMO_INVALID", "message": "coupon not found", "request_id": "req_9f3a2b" }
}
```

mike-cs: tagging @dan-platform and @tom-billing-bot. Can we do manual credit while we triage? Customer wants $50.

dan-platform: please paste the `request_id` and raw headers + code string. any non-ascii chars?

priya-support: request_id=req_9f3a2b
Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`, `Accept-Language: en-US`
Raw payload:
```
{ "account_id": "acct_555", "promo_code": "SPRING-50-NA" }
```

dan-platform: thanks. quick lookup shows coupon id=9987. note: there was a coupons schema migration pushed 2026-03-15T21:48Z. partial rollback happened 2026-03-15T21:52Z. It left a version tag mismatch for codes with region suffixes (like `-NA`). redemption service hits the new lookup path which is missing the alias entry -> 404.

mike-cs: can we re-issue the code or alias it now? customer waiting.

dan-platform: workaround: redeem using the alias `SPRING-50` (without region suffix) — we've verified alias still points to active promo. I'll open an internal ticket to fix the migration and backfill missing aliases.

tom-billing-bot: manual credit request accepted. Applying $50 to acct_555 now.

tom-billing-bot: Manual credit applied: txn_id=tx_9876, amount=50.00 USD, applied_by=tom-billing-bot, time=2026-03-16T00:05:31Z

priya-support: told customer we issued $50 credit and shared alias workaround. They confirmed receipt and are OK to wait for permanent fix. :relieved:

dan-platform: created INF-4021 with details + log extract. Root cause: migration left orphaned index and missing alias backfill for codes containing `-<region>` suffix. Patch planned (hotfix) + backfill script. ETA 6h.

deploy-bot: hotfix deployed to coupons service on 2026-03-16T05:02:12Z (commit abcdef123). Backfill job queued.

dan-platform: backfill started, monitoring for errors. I'll post updates in INF-4021. If anyone wants to validate a specific code, ping me.

priya-support: thanks all. closing this thread after backfill succeeds and customer email follow-up sent.

mike-cs: +1. good job everyone :tada:
